# 🌟 SeeleAI

> 让三位来自《崩坏3》的少女真正「住进」你的星露谷——她们会看你种地、陪你聊天、吐槽你翻垃圾桶，甚至在你晕倒时担心你。

该模组是一个为《星露谷物语》1.6 打造的**深度 AI 同伴模组**。借助 DeepSeek 大语言模型，三位个性迥异的少女——**希儿（Seele）**、**爱莉希雅（Elysia）**、**月下妖精德丽莎（Delilah）**——不再是固定台词的 NPC，而是会根据你的每一个行动**实时反应**的 AI 伙伴。

---

## 📦 安装

### 前置需求

| 组件 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **Stardew Valley 1.6+** | 游戏本体 |
| **SMAPI 4.0+** | Mod 加载器（[smapi.io](https://smapi.io)） |
| **Content Patcher** | CP 角色包依赖（Nexus Mods 搜索 Content Patcher） |
| **DeepSeek API 账户** | 获取 API Key：[platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) |
| **网络连接** | AI 对话需要实时调用云端 API |

### 安装步骤

1. 安装 SMAPI 和 Content Patcher
2. 将 `SeeleAI` 文件夹放入 `Stardew Valley/Mods/`
3. 将三个 CP 角色包 `[CP] Seele NPC`、`[CP] Elysia NPC`、`[CP] Delilah NPC` 也放入 `Mods/`
4. 启动游戏后，在API设置选项里（左上角）输入API
> 💡 **首次运行**：模组会自动将内置人物包复制到 Mods 目录。也可以在游戏中按 `F8` 随时配置 API Key。

## ✨ 核心功能

### 🗣 AI 实时对话

每天与每位 NPC 可进行**三阶段主题对话**，之后进入**自由聊天模式**：

| 阶段 | 名称 | 对话主题 |
|------|------|----------|
| 🌅 **第一段** | 晨间新闻 | 根据当日电视节目（运势/天气）开启话题，像朋友聊新闻 |
| 🌾 **第二段** | 农场巡视 | 根据你的农场真实状态——作物、动物、工匠设备——聊天 |
| 🎉 **第三段** | 生活闲聊 | 节日庆祝 / 生日祝福 / 朋友间的日常关心 |

每次对话末尾提供 **3 个情感选项卡**（如「鼓励她」「开玩笑」「认真回应」），玩家的选择会影响好感度。三轮主题结束后，输入框自由打字，**想聊什么就聊什么**。

## ❓ 常见问题

**Q: AI 回复要等多久？**
A: 通常 3~10 秒，取决于网络和 API 负载。可在 `config.json` 中降低 `MaxTokens` 来加快响应。

**Q: API 调用贵吗？**
A: DeepSeek 价格非常亲民——日常使用每月仅需几元人民币。注册即赠送免费额度。

**Q: 群聊太频繁了怎么办？**
A: 设置 `"EnableProactiveChat": false` 关闭自动触发群聊。手动按 `Enter` 的群聊不受影响。

**Q: 怎么切换英文？**
A: 全自动检测。只要游戏客户端是英文，模组就输出全英文。无需任何手动设置。

**Q: AI 偶尔说出不符合角色的话？**
A: 偶有发生，这是大语言模型的固有限制。系统提示词做了大量角色锚定，绝大多数时间表现稳定。遇到严重 OOC 可以关闭对话再重新开启来刷新上下文。

**Q: 存档之间会串数据吗？**
A: 不会。加载新存档时所有对话状态、记忆、快照全部重置，确保存档隔离。

# 🌟 SeeleAI

> Three girls from *Honkai Impact 3rd* move into your Stardew Valley — they watch you farm, chat with you, tease you for digging through trash, and worry when you pass out in the mines.

SeeleAI is a **deep AI companion mod** for Stardew Valley 1.6. Powered by the DeepSeek large language model, three distinct personalities — **Seele**, **Elysia**, and **Moonlight Vampire Delilah (TeriTeri)** — are no longer NPCs with static dialogue. They are AI companions who react to your every action in real time.

---

## 📦 Installation

### Requirements

| Component | Notes |
|-----------|-------|
| **Stardew Valley 1.6+** | Base game |
| **SMAPI 4.0+** | Mod loader ([smapi.io](https://smapi.io)) |
| **Content Patcher** | Required for CP character packs (search Nexus Mods) |
| **DeepSeek API Account** | Get your API key at [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) |
| **Internet Connection** | AI conversations require real-time cloud API access |

### Setup

1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Place the `SeeleAI` folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods/`
3. Place the three CP character packs — `[CP] Seele NPC`, `[CP] Elysia NPC`, `[CP] Delilah NPC` — into `Mods/` as well
4. Launch the game and enter your API key in the settings menu (top-left corner)

> 💡 **First launch**: The mod will automatically copy the built-in character packs into your Mods directory. You can also press `F8` in-game to configure your API key at any time.

---

## ✨ Core Features

### 🗣 Real-Time AI Conversations

Each day, every NPC offers a **three-stage themed conversation**, followed by **free chat mode**:

| Stage | Name | Topic |
|-------|------|-------|
| 🌅 **Stage 1** | Morning News | Opens with the day's TV program (luck forecast / weather), like chatting about the news with a friend |
| 🌾 **Stage 2** | Farm Tour | Discusses the real state of your farm — crops, animals, artisan equipment |
| 🎉 **Stage 3** | Life & Leisure | Festival celebrations / birthday wishes / everyday care between friends |

At the end of each conversation, **3 emotional response options** are presented (e.g. "Encourage her", "Tease her", "Respond seriously"). Your choice affects friendship points. After all three themed stages, an open text input appears — **chat about anything you want**.

---

### 👥 Smart Group Chat ⭐ Core Highlight

**Proactive event-triggered group chat** is the biggest upgrade in v2.0 — the NPCs no longer wait passively. They actively **observe your every move** and spontaneously discuss what you've been up to in the group chat!
(You can also press `Enter` anytime to start a manual group chat.)

#### 18 Event Triggers

#### Smart Anti-Spam

- ⏰ **Once per day**: Each event triggers at most once per in-game day
- 🧊 **Cooldown period**: A buffer window between group chats to avoid spam
- 📝 **History deduplication**: Events already in recent chat history will not re-trigger
- 🎮 **Manual group chat**: Press `Enter` anytime to start one — cooldown-free

#### Group Chat Style

The group chat simulates a "phone group chat" — alternating messages in the style of *Honkai: Star Rail*, 8–14 messages per session, casual and breezy in tone, distinctly different from the deeper one-on-one conversations. Group chat logs are saved to `GroupChatLog.txt` for you to revisit anytime.

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: How long do AI responses take?**
A: Typically 3–10 seconds, depending on network and API load. You can lower `MaxTokens` in `config.json` for faster responses.

**Q: Are the API calls expensive?**
A: DeepSeek is very affordable — daily use only costs a few cents / pence per month. Free credits are included upon registration.

**Q: The group chat triggers too often. How do I tone it down?**
A: Set `"EnableProactiveChat": false` to disable automatic group chat triggers. Manual group chats (pressing `Enter`) are unaffected.

**Q: How do I switch to English?**
A: Fully automatic. As long as your game client is in English, the mod outputs everything in English. No manual settings needed.

**Q: The AI occasionally says something out of character?**
A: It happens — an inherent limitation of large language models. The system prompts include extensive character anchoring, and performance is stable the vast majority of the time. If you encounter a severe OOC moment, close the conversation and reopen it to refresh the context.

**Q: Will data bleed across save files?**
A: No. All conversation states, memories, and snapshots reset completely when loading a new save, ensuring full save isolation.
